summary: Full end-to-end test of Mowasalat backend + smoke test of Expo web frontend. All 13 pytest cases pass (100%). Catalog, driver mock-OTP, trip lifecycle (start/progress/end + cap), passenger wait creation/status/board/cancel, end-to-end matching with correct state transitions coming->near->very_near, driver waiting aggregation, 401 auth, and privacy invariants (no raw GPS, admin only counts, pseudonymous bus IDs) all validated. Frontend renders role selection, passenger destinations list, waiting screen and driver login screen correctly on 390x844 viewport.

issues: Arabic joining artifacts on react-native-web (expected per problem statement, not tested)

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 494 lines - still within acceptable limit but approaching split threshold. Consider splitting into routers/models/state modules if it grows further.
In-memory state (ACTIVE_TRIPS/WAITING_REQUESTS/DRIVER_SESSIONS) is lost on backend restart - acceptable for MVP as documented, but flag for production migration to Redis.
Passenger frontend filters Irbid out of destination list (shows 6 of 7) which is correct pilot behavior (Irbid is the hub origin).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (smoke: role-selection + passenger destination pick + waiting screen + driver login all reachable)

seed_data_creation: Test drivers created in db.drivers via OTP verify with phones +962777777778 and +962700000001 (harmless upserts).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). State is in-memory and process-scoped; test flows must create their own trip/wait. Full reusable pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_mowasalat.py.
